notes.title: 13.03.2017 & 29.03.2017 Update
notes.content:
A new Update with plenty of Quality of Life improvements and Bugfixes just went live!

What changed:
[list][*]Add periodic table for guidance on the F2 key
[*]Add greying out tiles that are not combinable with the current highlighted atom for visual guidance
[*]Add hidden Achievement
[*]Fixed rare crash bug when dragging atoms
[*]Fixed common crash bug on Linux (you should no longer need the -noIcon launchoption)
[*]Updated bundled JRE to version 8u121 (this could potentially fix the "OpenGL 2.0 or higher with the FBO extension is required" bug on Windows 10)
[*]Fixed some minor visual bugs
[/list]

29.03.2017 Update:
[list][*]Fixed getting achievements on F2 help view[/list]

notes.title: 23.01.2017 Update
notes.content:
Linux:
[list][*]Add a launch option that fixes a crash on some systems.
[/list]

If the game does not start, try to set the launch option to "[b]-noIcon[/b]" (without the ")

You can find a tutorial on how to set launch options for games on steam here: https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=1040-JWMT-2947

notes.title: The Linux launch and Windows update
notes.content:
Exiting news!
The game is now available on linux for you to download!

If you are a windows user, you may experienced an update. This update just removed the need for that pesky cmd-window.

I also changed some boring minor technical stuff but who wants to read about that anyway.

So to all linux users out there: enjoy the game!

notes.title: 22.12.2016 Update
notes.content:
In todays update, I enabled software OpenGL as a fallback for graphic cards, that dont support Hardware accelerated OpenGL.

Keep in mind, that the game might run slow if it has to use software rendering, so if you run into lag problems, try to update your graphics driver!
